text: 韩国海关周六表示，今年迄今韩国出口额已达7094亿美元，超过了去年的全年纪录，这得益于全球对人工智能芯片需求的激增，推动韩国经济持续向好。该国去年的出口额为7093亿美元，连续第二年创下年度纪录。韩国海关总署称，作为亚洲第四大经济体，韩国今年有望实现年度出口额1万亿美元，成为继美国、中国和德国之后第四个达到这一里程碑的国家。韩国8月份出口额同比激增69%，连续第15个月保持增长势头。
text_en: Korea Customs said Saturday that the country's exports have reached $709.4 billion so far this year, surpassing last year's full-year record, driven by surging global demand for AI chips that continues to bolster Korea's economy. Last year's exports totaled $709.3 billion, setting an annual record for the second consecutive year. Korea Customs said the Asian fourth-largest economy is on track to achieve annual exports of $1 trillion this year, becoming the fourth country after the U.S., China, and Germany to reach that milestone. Korean exports in August surged 69% year-on-year, marking the 15th consecutive month of growth.
